lang.opt_controls_rebind_hint_mobile: Connect a keyboard or gamepad to rebind
lang.opt_controls_keybinds_locked: Connect a keyboard or gamepad to use Keybinds
lang.opt_shimeji_desc:
If checked, your currently equipped pet wanders around the screen and reacts when tapped, everywhere except during an actual song.
Equip a pet first from the Locker -- this has nothing to show without one.
lang.opt_downscroll_desc:
Enables downscroll.
 (Notes come from the top instead of bottom.)
lang.opt_middlescroll_desc:
Enables middlescroll.
 (Centers the player's notes and hides the opponent's.)
lang.opt_ghosttapping_desc:
Enables Ghost Tapping.
(Pressing keys when no notes are present won't count as misses.)
lang.opt_sustainsasonenote_desc:
Hold notes will be dropped if let go too early and only count as one miss.
Disable for the old input.
lang.opt_laneunderlay_desc: Adds a semi-transparent background behind the notes.
lang.opt_laneUnderlayStyle_desc: Changes the appearance or layering of the lane underlay(s).
lang.opt_opponentLaneUnderlay_desc: Shows the lane underlay behind the opponent's notes.
lang.opt_hitsoundvolume_desc: Adds a hitsound for every note hit.
lang.opt_cachemode_desc:
How loaded art is kept between screens.
Destructive: free the art a screen loaded when you leave it — lowest RAM, best for low-end devices.
Accumulative: keep everything loaded — faster returns and next-song loads, but RAM keeps growing. Best for high-end devices.
lang.opt_lowquality_desc:
Disables some background details,
decreases loading times and improves performance.
lang.opt_nostages_desc:
[EXPERIMENTAL] Stage backgrounds -- including scripted effects like flickers and spotlights -- are never created at all, for the biggest RAM/loading win.
Characters and the HUD are unaffected.
lang.opt_debugdisplaytype_desc:
Handles what type of information to display in the top left of your screen.
Simple displays FPS & Memory, and advanced displays the same alongside debug information.
Disabled disables the counter entirely.
lang.opt_framerate_desc: Changes the maximum framerate of the game.
lang.opt_timebar_desc: What should the Time Bar display?
lang.opt_hudrankdisplay_desc: What should be displayed on the HUD?
lang.opt_coloredui_desc:
Colors UI elements based on the opponent's icon color.
DX also tints the rating popup and combo digits to match.
(Some colors might be hard to read.)
lang.opt_photosensitivemode_desc:
Tones down screen flashes and other visual effects (such as quickly moving backgrounds).
Enable this if you're prone to photosensitive epilepsy.
lang.opt_camerazooms_desc: Enables the camera to zoom in on a beat hit. Uncheck to disable.
lang.opt_scoretextzoom_desc: Enables the Score text zooming everytime you hit a note.
lang.opt_afterimages_desc: Characters will leave afterimages on double notes. Uncheck to disable.
lang.opt_splashscreen_desc: If unchecked, it will completely skip the splash screen upon the engine's boot up.
lang.opt_devmode_desc: If checked, traces & developer hotkeys will become available.
lang.opt_streamedsongfiles_desc: Playable song files will be streamed via bytes instead of being loaded all at once. This heavily improves loading times, however it is EXTREMELY EXPERIMENTAL and prone to issues.
lang.opt_threadedpreload_desc: The loading screen decodes the next song's assets on a background thread while the bar animates. If unchecked, it just waits, and PlayState loads everything itself the plain, one-at-a-time way.
lang.opt_autopause_desc: The game will automatically freeze when unselected, pausing all sounds and visuals. If unchecked, the game will continue as normal regardless of focus.
lang.opt_discordrpc_desc: Shows your current song/menu as your Discord status.
lang.opt_discordrpc_desc_android: Makes your current song/menu available as a Discord status via a local MediaSession. Requires the free "Kizzy" app installed and configured separately -- this only makes the status available for it to pick up, it cannot detect whether Kizzy is actually installed.
lang.opt_quants_desc: Colors notes in-game based on their step value. Helpful for timing your note hits.
lang.opt_notesplashes_desc: Hitting "Sick!" or "Sussy!" notes show note-splash particles.
lang.opt_language_desc: Choose your language! Note: All languages besides English (United States) are community translated!
lang.opt_subtitles_desc: Subtitles will be shown on screen during cutscenes and song animations.
lang.opt_unlockedFramerate_desc: Unlocks the game's framerate. Uses more CPU power but might help with input latency.
lang.opt_vsyncMode_desc: Syncs the game's framerate to your monitor's refresh rate to prevent screen tearing.
lang.opt_backgroundStrumlines_desc: If enabled, additional characters' strumlines will be shown on screen whenever applicable.
lang.opt_discord_desc: If enabled, the game will show up in your Discord Activity Status while playing.

lang.AWARDS_SECRET: Keep playing to unlock this secret!
lang.opt_perfpreset_desc:
Quickly apply a quality profile.
Low boosts performance, High enables everything.
Custom lets you configure each setting individually.
lang.opt_gpucaching_desc_android:
[EXPERIMENTAL — ANDROID]
Frees RAM after uploading textures to the GPU.
If the app is minimized or a call comes in, the OpenGL context is lost -- affected textures are automatically re-uploaded when you return, but this recovery is untested on real hardware.
Disabled by default. Enable only if you don't mind the risk.
lang.opt_drs_desc:
Auto-drops render rate to ~30fps when the game falls below 30fps,
keeping gameplay logic at full speed.
Disable if you prefer consistent frame pacing at all times.
lang.opt_fpsrgb_desc:
Cycles the FPS counter color through the rainbow.
Works with both Simple and Advanced display modes.
lang.opt_debugdisplaysize_desc: Scales the top-left FPS/debug overlay up or down.
lang.opt_navinput_desc:
How you interact with menus and UI.
Touch uses native screen taps. Virtual Pad shows on-screen buttons.
lang.opt_gameinput_desc:
How you hit notes in-game.
Hitbox: split-screen zones (this is what VSlice's own mobile app actually uses). Virtual Pad: D-pad buttons. Note Tap: tap the note receptors directly (requires VSlice Note Layout).
lang.opt_notelayout_desc:
Visual arrangement of notes.
Normal: standard FNF layout.
VSlice: centered, wider spacing, bigger arrows.
lang.opt_padskin_desc:
Look of the on-screen pad buttons.
Modern: translucent glass circles with FNF-style note arrows.
Classic: the original button art.
Neon: glowing outline rings.
Flat: solid flat squircles, no gradient.
Pixel: chunky 8-bit-style blocks.
lang.opt_hitboxlayout_desc:
Arrangement of the tap zones.
Four Lanes: four columns. Two Thumb: 2×2 grid. DPad: circular buttons. Arrows: note-style arrows.
lang.opt_hitboxalpha_desc: How visible the hitbox zones appear when pressed.
lang.opt_hitboxhints_desc: Keep the tap zones faintly visible at all times (scaled to your Hitbox Opacity) instead of only flashing in when pressed.
lang.opt_roundpausebtn_desc: Use a bigger, smoother, more transparent circular pause button during gameplay instead of the plain square one.
lang.opt_padopacity_desc: How visible the virtual pad buttons appear.
lang.opt_vpadlayout_desc:
Arrangement of the virtual pad buttons.
LeftFull: left side diamond. RightFull: right side diamond. Custom: user-defined positions.
lang.opt_vpadcustomize_desc: Open the pad customizer to drag buttons to new positions.
lang.opt_aspectratio_desc:
How the game fills the screen.
Fit: keeps 16:9 with black bars. Stretch: fills screen (may distort).
lang.opt_storagemode_desc:
Where mods/DLC/saves are stored.
Shared: the classic folder, visible to any file manager, needs "All files access". App-Only: no special permission needed, but only reachable from this app, and gets deleted if you uninstall.
Existing mods/DLC only reappear after switching back and restarting.
lang.opt_storagemode_confirm_msg: Mods/DLC already loaded this session will still be from the old location until the game restarts. Restart now?
lang.opt_opendatafolder_desc:
Opens the game data folder in your file manager.
Use this to install mods or access save files.
